subject: NeonLaunch pilot credits, packaging options & one-off exception
messages:
From: Sana Malik <sana@neonlaunch.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits + pricing for NeonLaunch cohort

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. We run a seasonal accelerator (12 companies this quarter) and are evaluating partner credits / pilot structures. Two quick asks we hope you can help with:

1) Can Redwood allow stacking of startup promo credits with a short-term committed discount if a cohort converts to Dedicated within 90 days? Our finance team needs to understand whether credits can be applied and then converted to committed capacity pricing without double-counting.

2) We have a modest procurement / accounting constraint: credits need to be visible on invoice (or as an addendum) so our sponsors can reimburse. Any standard addendum you use for promo credits?

Attached a short requirements doc (NeonLaunch-Requirements.pdf) with estimated usage per startup. Rough numbers: 12 companies, average 200k tokens/month first two months, heavier during demo week.

Happy to hop on a short call next week — we are on Pacific time.

Best,
Sana Malik
Director, Partnerships
NeonLaunch Labs
attachments: NeonLaunch-Requirements.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Malik <sana@neonlaunch.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + pricing for NeonLaunch cohort

Sana —

Thanks for the note and the deck. Short answers up front: yes, we can support an exception path for accelerator cohorts, but there are a few nuances we should align on. See options below — I want to loop Ben and Laura to confirm commercial feasibility and invoicing flow.

Quick options (high level):
- Option A: Standard promo credits (non-expiring for 90 days) + conversion credit: if any company converts to Dedicated within 90 days, we allow a one-time applied credit equal to 15% of consumed tokens toward the first month of Dedicated.
- Option B: Rollover credits with cap: credits can be rolled into a committed contract but only up to 50% of the dollar value; remaining credits are accounted as promo (no cash liability).
- Option C: Promo + invoice addendum: provide a one-page addendum that shows credit issuance (for sponsor reimbursement) and a signed acceptance.

Questions for you:
- Do sponsors require line-item level visibility (per-company) or is a single cohort-level invoice sufficient?
- Any companies expecting sustained high throughput (100k+ tokens/min) during demo day?

Ben / Laura — can one of you confirm whether we have an approved accelerator exception (non-standard credit stacking) and whether finance will accept the addendum approach?

— Hannah
VP, Partnerships (Growth)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot credits + pricing for NeonLaunch cohort

Hannah / Laura —

I pulled a quick pricing sketch and a term-sheet draft (see attached Promo-credits-term-sheet.pdf). High level proposal we can offer NeonLaunch:

- Accelerator Tiering (per cohort):
  * Tier A (Demo cohort): 50k promo credits per company + 15% conversion credit applied to month-1 Dedicated invoice if conversion occurs in 90 days.
  * Tier B (Standard cohort): 25k promo credits per company + 10% conversion credit.
  * Sponsor package: cohort-level invoice showing credit issuance for reimbursement.

- Exception ask: We can allow promo credits to be stacked with a one-time conversion discount but only under a signed addendum and a cap (no more than 50% of promo value rolled).

- Financials / Accounting note: Finance will require a DocuSign addendum that: 1) lists credit amounts, 2) notes conversion cap, and 3) states that unused promo credits expire after 90 days unless explicitly rolled by a signed commitment.

Recommended next steps:
1) Approve the exception path (I recommend approving a one-time extra credit bonus of 10% for early cohorts to help conversion).
2) Send the addendum template to NeonLaunch for signature and confirm per-company invoicing requirements.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-937 (I added the estimates).

Attaching: Promo-credits-term-sheet.pdf (pricing matrix + sample addendum language).

— Ben
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Promo-credits-term-sheet.pdf

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot credits + pricing for NeonLaunch cohort

Team —

I approve a constrained exception for NeonLaunch: we will offer a one-time 10% bonus on top of the Tier A credits for this upcoming demo cohort, subject to the following guardrails:

1) DocuSign addendum signed by NeonLaunch and Redwood before credits are issued (finance needs addendum ID on the invoice).
2) Unused promo credits expire after 90 days; any roll-to-commit must be explicitly elected and is capped at 50% of the original credit dollar value.
3) If a company converts to Dedicated and requires upfront committed capacity, we will apply the agreed conversion credit against the first month invoice but not refund cash.

Ben — please prepare the DocuSign packet using the templated addendum (link below) and include per-company line items if NeonLaunch requests sponsor reimbursement documentation. I will notify finance to expect the paperwork.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/NEON-ADDENDUM-933

Hannah — once you get a response from NeonLaunch on per-company vs cohort invoicing, we can finalize the addendum and send. I recommend offering a 30-minute call to walk sponsors through the invoice layout.

— Laura
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
